topic.title: Chapter 1: Introduction
topic.shortdesc: An introduction to DITA and EPUB transformation.

body.p: This chapter introduces the fundamental concepts of DITA to EPUB transformation using modern tools and standards.

section.title: What is DITA?
section.p: DITA (Darwin Information Typing Architecture) is an XML standard for creating and managing content. It provides:

ul.li: Content reuse through conref and keyref

section.title: What is EPUB3?
section.p: EPUB3 is the third major revision of the EPUB standard. Key features include:

body.note: Modern EPUB3 readers provide excellent support for accessibility features, making content available to wider audiences.

section.title: Why Transform DITA to EPUB?
section.p: Converting DITA content to EPUB provides several benefits:

row.entry: EPUB files work on multiple devices and platforms
Users can read content without internet connection
Built-in support for screen readers and assistive technologies
Content adapts to different screen sizes
